purpose: Verify that an institutional file is managed as a persistent composite record whose accumulated contents and lifecycle trace are preserved after circulation.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee with file-creation privileges.
action_or_input: Create file with comment and attachment, circulate to recipient, add movement comments, and complete workflow.
expected_result: File record persists with all accumulated comments, attachments, and chronological movement trace intact without deletion.

purpose: Verify that FTS treats each file as a composite object consisting of mandatory comments and optional attachments.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Create a new file supplying mandatory initial comment and an optional file attachment.
expected_result: File is persisted containing both the mandatory comment and attached file entity.

purpose: Verify that circulated files and their accumulated contents are preserved without deletion.
preconditions: A file has been created, submitted, and circulated between employees.
action_or_input: Attempt deletion of the circulated file or its associated comments/attachments.
expected_result: Deletion is prevented; file and all accumulated comments and attachments remain intact.

purpose: Verify that a file owner can archive a completed file instead of deleting it.
preconditions: Circulated file where collaborative objective is complete; actor is the file owner.
action_or_input: File owner initiates file archival.
expected_result: File transitions to archived state and remains permanently stored rather than deleted.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains end-to-end traceability of file creation, movement, comments, attachments, and archival.
preconditions: File that has undergone creation, multiple forwards, returns, and archival.
action_or_input: Retrieve the complete file movement and audit trace.
expected_result: Trace includes all creation details, movement steps, timestamps, comments, attachments, and archival record in chronological order.

purpose: Verify role separation between Institute Employees (operational file users) and System Admin (governance actor).
preconditions: System Admin and Faculty/Staff accounts exist.
action_or_input: Institute Employee performs file operations; System Admin oversees governance without performing routine file operations.
expected_result: Employee file operations succeed; governance functions are accessible to System Admin.

purpose: Verify that Faculty and Staff Institute Employees can operate file workflows under assigned roles.
preconditions: Faculty and Staff users with assigned roles in FTS.
action_or_input: Faculty and Staff users initiate file creation and forwarding workflows.
expected_result: Operational file actions proceed successfully for authorized faculty and staff employees.

purpose: Verify that System Admin can administer FTS-relevant role assignments, reassignments, and access control.
preconditions: Authenticated System Admin.
action_or_input: System Admin assigns or reassigns an FTS role to an employee.
expected_result: Role assignment/reassignment is recorded and updated access control context takes effect.

purpose: Verify that System Admin can monitor FTS system usage within available governance scope.
preconditions: Authenticated System Admin.
action_or_input: System Admin requests system usage statistics/metrics within FTS governance scope.
expected_result: FTS usage information is presented to the System Admin.

purpose: Verify that System Admin can view and oversee FTS security and audit logs.
preconditions: Authenticated System Admin; audit records exist in system.
action_or_input: System Admin accesses FTS security and audit log views.
expected_result: Audit logs are retrieved and displayed for governance oversight.

purpose: Verify that System Admin is blocked from performing operational file workflow actions on behalf of Institute Employees.
preconditions: Authenticated System Admin.
action_or_input: System Admin attempts to create, forward, return, or archive an operational file.
expected_result: Action is denied; operational file actions cannot be performed by System Admin.

purpose: Verify that an Institute Employee with multiple assigned institutional roles can operate under a selected role.
preconditions: Institute Employee assigned multiple active roles (e.g. Faculty and HOD).
action_or_input: Employee switches active role context and performs a file operation under the selected role.
expected_result: Operation is evaluated and executed under permissions of the selected active role.

purpose: Verify that an authorized Institute Employee can create a new file under an assigned role with mandatory initial comment and optional attachments.
preconditions: Institute Employee authenticated under an assigned role authorized to create files.
action_or_input: Submit file creation request with subject, initial comment, and attachment.
expected_result: File is created successfully with subject, comment, and attachment linked to creator role.

purpose: Verify that any Institute Employee can create a new file under their assigned role.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee with assigned role.
action_or_input: Initiate new file creation with required fields and mandatory comment.
expected_result: New file is created with creator identified under their assigned role.

purpose: Verify that file creation succeeds when a non-empty initial mandatory comment is provided.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Create file with non-empty initial comment string.
expected_result: File creation succeeds and initial comment is stored.

purpose: Verify that file creation is rejected when the initial mandatory comment is missing or empty.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a file without supplying an initial comment or with whitespace-only comment.
expected_result: File creation is rejected with validation error; no file is persisted.

purpose: Verify that optional file attachments can be added during file creation.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Create a new file including one or more valid file attachments alongside mandatory comment.
expected_result: File is created and attachments are persisted and linked to the initial creation event.

purpose: Verify pre-circulation draft handling (save, edit, discard) and transition into circulation upon submission.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Save draft, edit draft, submit to recipient, and verify draft discard is blocked post-circulation.
expected_result: Draft progresses through save, edit, transitions to circulated state on send, and cannot be discarded thereafter.

purpose: Verify that an Institute Employee can save a newly created file as a draft.
preconditions: Authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Create new file and select Save as Draft.
expected_result: File is persisted with draft/pre-circulation status and is not visible in recipient inbox.

purpose: Verify that an Institute Employee can edit a saved draft file before submission.
preconditions: Existing saved draft file owned by authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Update draft fields (comment, attachments, subject) and save.
expected_result: Draft is updated with new values and remains in draft/pre-circulation status.

purpose: Verify that an Institute Employee can discard a draft file before submission.
preconditions: Existing saved draft file owned by authenticated Institute Employee.
action_or_input: Initiate draft discard on the pre-circulation file.
expected_result: Draft file is discarded and removed from active files.

purpose: Verify that once submitted and circulated, a file cannot be deleted.
preconditions: File that has been submitted and circulated to another employee.
action_or_input: Attempt delete/discard operation on the circulated file.
expected_result: Delete request is rejected; file remains active and unchanged in circulation.

purpose: Verify that file transitions from draft to circulated workflow state upon submission.
preconditions: Existing draft file owned by sender.
action_or_input: Submit file to recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File status transitions from draft to circulated/active; file appears in recipient inbox.

purpose: Verify that comments and attachments accumulated in a draft file are preserved after submission.
preconditions: Draft file with comments and attachments.
action_or_input: Submit file to recipient.
expected_result: All pre-existing comments and attachments are preserved in full after entering circulation.

purpose: Verify authorized forwarding and return of active files with mandatory comments, optional attachments, holder updates, and chronological tracking.
preconditions: Active circulated file between two Institute Employees.
action_or_input: Forward file to recipient with comment, then recipient returns file to sender with comment.
expected_result: Both movements succeed; holder updates accurately; all comments and actions are chronologically recorded.

purpose: Verify that an Institute Employee can send an active file to another Institute Employee.
preconditions: Active file held by sender; valid recipient exists.
action_or_input: Send file to recipient with mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: File is transferred to recipient and recorded in sender outbox and recipient inbox.

purpose: Verify that a file can be sent to any Institute Employee regardless of their institutional role.
preconditions: Active file held by sender; recipients with different roles (e.g. Faculty, Staff, Admin roleholders).
action_or_input: Send file to employees holding different organizational roles.
expected_result: File transfer succeeds across differing role categories without role-hierarchy restrictions.

purpose: Verify that forwarding succeeds when mandatory movement comment is provided.
preconditions: Active file held by sender.
action_or_input: Forward file with valid non-empty movement comment.
expected_result: Forward action succeeds and movement comment is recorded.

purpose: Verify that forwarding is blocked when mandatory movement comment is missing or empty.
preconditions: Active file held by sender.
action_or_input: Attempt to forward file with empty or missing comment.
expected_result: Forwarding is rejected with validation error; file holder remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that returning a file is blocked when mandatory movement comment is missing or empty.
preconditions: Active file held by recipient.
action_or_input: Attempt to return file to previous sender without providing a movement comment.
expected_result: Return is rejected with validation error; file remains with current recipient.

purpose: Verify that optional attachments can be added during forwarding and return actions.
preconditions: Active file ready for forward or return.
action_or_input: Execute forward or return providing a new file attachment along with mandatory comment.
expected_result: Movement succeeds and new attachment is linked to this movement stage in file history.

purpose: Verify that a recipient of a received file can forward it onward to another employee.
preconditions: File received by employee (current holder).
action_or_input: Recipient forwards file to a third Institute Employee with mandatory comment.
expected_result: File is forwarded onward; third employee becomes current holder.

purpose: Verify that a recipient user can return a received file to the sender.
preconditions: File received by employee with known previous sender.
action_or_input: Recipient initiates Return to sender with mandatory comment.
expected_result: File returns to previous sender who becomes the active holder again.

purpose: Verify that each forwarding action is recorded in strict chronological order.
preconditions: File subjected to sequential forwarding steps.
action_or_input: Perform multiple sequential forward actions with timestamps.
expected_result: Movement history lists each forward event ordered chronologically by timestamp.

purpose: Verify that each return action is recorded in strict chronological order.
preconditions: File subjected to return actions.
action_or_input: Perform return action following a forward action.
expected_result: Return event is appended to movement history chronologically following prior forward events.

purpose: Verify that current file holder is updated immediately upon forward or return.
preconditions: Active file held by employee A.
action_or_input: Employee A forwards file to employee B.
expected_result: File current holder is updated to employee B; employee A is no longer current holder.

purpose: Verify Inbox and Outbox views and access control based on user role and file state until archival.
preconditions: User with received files and sent files in system.
action_or_input: Query user Inbox and Outbox, open files, and verify available actions align with role and file state.
expected_result: Inbox lists received files, Outbox lists sent files; opening shows authorized details; available actions match file state.

purpose: Verify that files received by a user appear in the user Inbox.
preconditions: File sent to user B by user A.
action_or_input: User B queries their Inbox.
expected_result: Sent file appears in user B Inbox with correct sender and status information.

purpose: Verify that files sent by a user appear in the user Outbox.
preconditions: File sent by user A to user B.
action_or_input: User A queries their Outbox.
expected_result: File appears in user A Outbox with recipient details and current status.

purpose: Verify that users can view and open files from their Inbox.
preconditions: File present in user Inbox.
action_or_input: User opens the file details from Inbox.
expected_result: File contents, comments, attachments, and tracking status are displayed to user.

purpose: Verify that users can view and open files from their Outbox.
preconditions: File present in user Outbox.
action_or_input: User opens the file details from Outbox.
expected_result: File contents, comments, attachments, and tracking status are displayed to user.

purpose: Verify that a user can act on files from Inbox or Outbox according to file state and authorization.
preconditions: User is current holder of an active file in Inbox.
action_or_input: User initiates forward, return, or comment actions.
expected_result: Permitted actions succeed; non-permitted actions (e.g. forward by non-holder) are blocked.

purpose: Verify that files remain accessible to associated users until archived by the file owner.
preconditions: Active circulated file with sender, recipient, and owner associations.
action_or_input: Associated users access file at various stages before archival.
expected_result: File remains accessible for viewing and permitted actions to all associated users.

purpose: Verify complete chronological tracking history viewable by authorized associated users.
preconditions: File with multi-step movement history.
action_or_input: Authorized associated user requests file tracking history.
expected_result: Full movement history is retrieved displaying all required sender, receiver, timestamp, comment, and attachment details.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains complete movement history for every file from creation onward.
preconditions: File created and circulated through multiple holders.
action_or_input: Query file movement history.
expected_result: All events from initial creation to current status are present in the history log.

purpose: Verify that sender details are recorded for each file movement event.
preconditions: File forward or return movement performed.
action_or_input: Inspect movement event in history.
expected_result: Sender identity and role information are accurately recorded.

purpose: Verify that receiver details are recorded for each file movement event.
preconditions: File forward or return movement performed.
action_or_input: Inspect movement event in history.
expected_result: Receiver identity and role information are accurately recorded.

purpose: Verify that timestamps are recorded for each file movement event.
preconditions: File movement performed at known system time.
action_or_input: Inspect timestamp of recorded movement event.
expected_result: Valid timestamp is recorded corresponding to time of action execution.

purpose: Verify that comments added at each file movement event are recorded.
preconditions: File movement performed with specific comment text.
action_or_input: Inspect recorded movement in history.
expected_result: Movement comment text is accurately stored and associated with the movement event.

purpose: Verify that attachments added at each file movement event are recorded.
preconditions: File movement performed with an attached document.
action_or_input: Inspect recorded movement in history.
expected_result: Attachment metadata and file reference are linked to that specific movement event.

purpose: Verify that any user associated with a file can view its tracking history.
preconditions: User who is creator, sender, or receiver of a file movement.
action_or_input: Associated user requests file tracking history.
expected_result: Tracking history is displayed in full.

purpose: Verify that a user not associated with a file cannot view its tracking history.
preconditions: User with no prior association (not creator, sender, recipient, or current holder) to file.
action_or_input: Unassociated user attempts to retrieve tracking history of file.
expected_result: Request is denied; history details are not disclosed.

purpose: Verify owner-controlled archival and permanent read-only, non-modifiable, non-forwardable archival state.
preconditions: Circulated file whose collaborative objective is complete.
action_or_input: Owner archives file; attempt subsequent edit, forward, and read actions.
expected_result: Archival succeeds; subsequent edits and forwards are blocked; read access remains available.

purpose: Verify that the file owner can archive a circulated file.
preconditions: Circulated file held by or associated with file owner.
action_or_input: File owner initiates archive action.
expected_result: File transitions to archived status.

purpose: Verify that users other than the file owner are prevented from archiving the file.
preconditions: Circulated file; actor is a recipient or holder but NOT the file owner.
action_or_input: Non-owner attempts to archive the file.
expected_result: Archival request is denied; file remains active in its current state.

purpose: Verify that archival represents completion of collaborative file workflow.
preconditions: Active circulated file.
action_or_input: Owner archives the file.
expected_result: File status is updated to archived/completed; active collaborative processing is terminated.

purpose: Verify that archived files remain permanently stored and readable to authorized users.
preconditions: Archived file in system.
action_or_input: Authorized associated user opens archived file.
expected_result: File details, comments, attachments, and history are retrievable in read-only format.

purpose: Verify that modification of an archived file is prevented.
preconditions: File in archived status.
action_or_input: Attempt to edit comments, add attachments, or alter metadata on archived file.
expected_result: Modification request is rejected; archived file contents remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify that forwarding of an archived file is prevented.
preconditions: File in archived status.
action_or_input: Attempt to forward the archived file to another user.
expected_result: Forwarding request is rejected; file remains in archived status.

purpose: Verify RBAC enforcement, file association checks, and preservation of ownership and audit history across role switches.
preconditions: Institute Employee with multiple assigned roles who has created and moved files.
action_or_input: Employee switches active role and attempts file operations.
expected_result: Authorization reflects active role; file ownership of previously created files and past audit records remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify that FTS enforces role-based access control for all file operations.
preconditions: User whose assigned role lacks permission for a specific file operation.
action_or_input: User attempts the restricted file operation.
expected_result: Operation is blocked by RBAC check with access denied.

purpose: Verify that users can access only files they are authorized to view.
preconditions: File exists with which user X has no association.
action_or_input: User X attempts to view file details.
expected_result: View access is denied; file details are not exposed.

purpose: Verify that users can act only on files they are authorized to act upon.
preconditions: File held by employee A; employee B is not current holder.
action_or_input: Employee B attempts to forward or return employee A file.
expected_result: Action is denied; only authorized current holder may execute movement actions.

purpose: Verify that file ownership is preserved when an employee switches active roles.
preconditions: Employee owns a file created under role R1; employee also has role R2.
action_or_input: Employee switches active role context from R1 to R2.
expected_result: File ownership remains tied to the employee; creator/owner identity is not altered or transferred.

purpose: Verify that recorded audit history is preserved without change when a user switches roles.
preconditions: File with recorded audit history entries under role R1.
action_or_input: User switches active role to R2.
expected_result: Previously recorded audit entries retain their original actor identity and timestamps unaltered.

purpose: Verify that sensitive administrative/governance actions are restricted according to assigned roles.
preconditions: Regular Institute Employee without administrative privileges.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to access FTS administrative governance endpoints or role-reassignment APIs.
expected_result: Access is denied; sensitive governance actions require appropriate administrative role.

purpose: Verify audit records and chronological versioning for creation, comments, attachments, forwarding, return, archival, and integration actions.
preconditions: File subjected to creation, attachment, movement, archival, and API actions.
action_or_input: Inspect audit log entries generated across the file lifecycle.
expected_result: Dedicated audit log records exist for each auditable action with action type, actor, timestamp, and details.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains an audit log for file creation actions.
preconditions: New file created.
action_or_input: Inspect audit logs for file creation event.
expected_result: Audit record exists capturing creator, timestamp, initial comment, and file identifier.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains an audit log for comments added to files.
preconditions: Comment added during creation or file movement.
action_or_input: Inspect audit logs for comment addition.
expected_result: Audit entry logs the comment text, author, timestamp, and associated file.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains an audit log for attachments added to files.
preconditions: Attachment uploaded during creation or movement.
action_or_input: Inspect audit logs for attachment addition.
expected_result: Audit entry logs attachment filename, uploader, timestamp, and associated file.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains an audit log for forwarding actions.
preconditions: File forwarded from sender to recipient.
action_or_input: Inspect audit logs for forwarding event.
expected_result: Audit record exists capturing sender, receiver, timestamp, and movement action.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains an audit log for return actions.
preconditions: File returned by recipient to previous sender.
action_or_input: Inspect audit logs for return event.
expected_result: Audit record exists capturing returning actor, recipient, timestamp, and return action.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains an audit log for archival actions.
preconditions: File archived by owner.
action_or_input: Inspect audit logs for archival event.
expected_result: Audit record exists capturing owner identity, timestamp, and archival status transition.

purpose: Verify that FTS maintains chronological file versioning through recorded updates.
preconditions: File updated sequentially via drafts, comments, attachments, and movements.
action_or_input: Inspect version/update trace.
expected_result: Chronological sequence of updates represents ordered state versions without overwriting historical state.

purpose: Verify that FTS triggers required notification events on file received, forwarded, returned, archived, and role reassigned, handing them to Fusion notification mechanism.
preconditions: Integrated environment where Fusion notification handler is listening.
action_or_input: Trigger file receive, forward, return, archive, and role assignment events.
expected_result: Each corresponding notification event is generated and dispatched to the notification interface.

purpose: Verify that FTS generates a notification event when a file is received by a user.
preconditions: File forwarded to recipient user B.
action_or_input: Check triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification event for file received is triggered for user B.

purpose: Verify that FTS generates a notification event when a file is forwarded.
preconditions: File forwarded by user A to user B.
action_or_input: Check triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification event for file forwarded is generated with appropriate file details.

purpose: Verify that FTS generates a notification event when a file is returned.
preconditions: File returned by user B to user A.
action_or_input: Check triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification event for file returned is triggered for the previous sender.

purpose: Verify that FTS generates a notification event when a file is archived.
preconditions: File owner archives completed circulated file.
action_or_input: Check triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification event for file archived is triggered.

purpose: Verify that FTS generates a notification event when an FTS role is assigned or reassigned.
preconditions: System Admin assigns or reassigns an FTS role to an employee.
action_or_input: Check triggered notification events.
expected_result: Notification event for role assignment/reassignment is generated.

purpose: Verify that FTS hands notification payloads to Fusion integrated notification mechanisms.
preconditions: FTS notification event triggered.
action_or_input: Observe delivery mechanism handshake.
expected_result: Notification payload is successfully transferred to the Fusion notification dispatcher.

purpose: Verify that FTS exposes authorized APIs to other Fusion modules under RBAC and audit controls while preserving scope boundaries.
preconditions: Authorized external Fusion module calling FTS service APIs.
action_or_input: Invoke workflow support, approval chain, and tracking APIs with valid authorization and context.
expected_result: FTS executes requests under RBAC, records audit entries, and does not enforce consuming module domain policies.

purpose: Verify that FTS exposes APIs to other Fusion modules for module-specific workflows.
preconditions: Authorized external module invoking FTS API.
action_or_input: Call FTS workflow API with module context.
expected_result: FTS creates or updates file workflow instance on behalf of calling module.

purpose: Verify that FTS exposes APIs to other Fusion modules to support approval chains.
preconditions: Authorized external module with multi-stage approval requirement.
action_or_input: Call FTS API to route file along an approval chain.
expected_result: FTS records movement and updates holder according to approval stage parameters.

purpose: Verify that FTS exposes APIs to other Fusion modules for file-based request tracking.
preconditions: Authorized external module tracking a request.
action_or_input: Call FTS tracking API with file identifier.
expected_result: FTS returns tracking history and current holder/status information to calling module.

purpose: Verify that FTS applies RBAC requirements to integrations with other Fusion modules.
preconditions: Unauthenticated or unauthorized external module client.
action_or_input: Attempt to call FTS integration APIs without valid credentials/permissions.
expected_result: Request is rejected with authorization failure.

purpose: Verify that FTS applies audit logging requirements to integrations with other Fusion modules.
preconditions: Authorized external module calls FTS API.
action_or_input: Execute file action via integration API.
expected_result: FTS logs audit entry attributing action to integration client/module context.

purpose: Verify that FTS does not define or enforce domain-specific approval rules of consuming modules.
preconditions: Consuming module invoking FTS API.
action_or_input: Consuming module sends approval workflow action; FTS executes file movement without validating consuming module internal domain criteria.
expected_result: FTS handles file tracking mechanism only; domain validation remains with calling module.
